about_short_description.short_description: Nimble Robotics is an AI robotics and e-commerce fulfillment technology company, automating the processes of picking and packing products.

product.name: Robotic Fulfillment Centers
product.description: Autonomous warehouses using AI-powered general-purpose robots to perform all core fulfillment tasks including storage, retrieval, picking, packing, and sorting.

product.name: Cloud Logistics Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that manages and optimizes warehouse, inventory, order, and transportation operations with real-time supply chain visibility.

product.name: Transportation Network
product.description: A network of last-mile carriers and freight partners optimized for speed, cost, and sustainability from factory to customer delivery.

product.name: Robotic 3PL Fulfillment Service
product.description: A third-party logistics service using Nimble's autonomous robotic fulfillment centers to pick, pack, and ship orders without upfront investment.
